name: Indu Saral
role: Science Teacher · Classes up to Grade 10
tagline: Helping curious minds discover the wonder of science.
description: Portfolio of Indu Saral, Science Teacher at Winter Wood Global School, Morena, and M.Sc. Zoology student at Jiwaji University, Gwalior.
heroText: I’m a science educator who believes that strong foundations, thoughtful explanations, and hands-on curiosity help students understand the world—not just memorise it.
aboutParagraphOne: I’m Indu Saral, a Science Teacher at Winter Wood Global School in Morena, teaching Science up to Class 10. I aim to make concepts clear, encourage questions, and help students build confidence in their own understanding.
aboutParagraphTwo: My background in Biology, along with my ongoing postgraduate studies in Zoology, supports my interest in scientific thinking and the living world. I value patient explanation, structured lessons, positive classroom relationships, and steady progress.
approachIntro: Science becomes more approachable when students can connect concepts to the world around them, ask questions freely, and learn step by step.

approaches.title: Concepts before cramming
approaches.text: Break down difficult science topics into clear, manageable explanations and connect ideas to familiar, real-life examples.

approaches.title: Curiosity in every lesson
approaches.text: Invite students to observe, ask questions, think critically, and explore the reasons behind scientific ideas.

approaches.title: Supportive learning
approaches.text: Use patient guidance, structured practice, and constructive feedback to help learners strengthen their foundations and confidence.

journeyIntro: My academic foundation in Biology and ongoing study in Zoology inform my teaching, alongside experience supporting learners from primary through secondary school.

experience.title: Science Teacher · Winter Wood Global School, Morena (MP)
experience.text: Teaching Science up to Class 10. Focused on helping students understand core concepts, develop scientific thinking, and build confidence through clear explanations and structured learning.

experience.title: Self-employed Home Tutor
experience.text: Provided individual tutoring for Grades 1–10 in Science, English, Social Science, and General Knowledge. Planned lessons around learner needs, strengthened subject foundations, and supported preparation for school and board examinations.

education.title: M.Sc. Zoology · T.S.S. College
education.text: Currently pursuing postgraduate study in Zoology, affiliated with Jiwaji University, Gwalior (MP).

education.title: B.Sc. Biology · Sant Govindram Shadani Girls College
education.text: Studied Botany, Zoology, and Chemistry at Sant Govindram Shadani Girls College, affiliated with Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University, Raipur (CG).

projectsIntro: Explore classroom learning through science activities, hands-on models, educational exhibitions, and worksheets that help students understand scientific concepts through practical experiences.

projects.title: Everyday science
projects.text: Explore how scientific principles appear in everyday life through familiar examples, observation, and thought-provoking questions.

projects.title: Explore the living world
projects.text: Discover biology through clear explanations, labelled diagrams, and the study of living organisms and their interactions with the environment.

projects.title: Learn it step by step
projects.text: Build strong subject foundations through structured explanations, guided practice, revision questions, and step-by-step concept development.

projects.title: Question corner
projects.text: Encourage scientific thinking by asking questions, examining evidence, explaining ideas, and exploring the reasons behind everyday phenomena.

philosophyQuote: “The goal is not only to teach a scientific fact, but to help a student become curious enough to ask the next question.”
contactText: For teaching opportunities, school collaborations, or professional enquiries, feel free to get in touch.
footerLine: Helping curious minds discover the wonder of science.

customSections.title: Activities & certifications
customSections.body: Participated in school science exhibitions and quiz competitions, volunteered in school functions and cultural-event coordination, and was an active member of the school nature and environment club. Certifications include Scout & Guide training, a school-level General Knowledge Test certificate, and CPR (Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation) awareness training.
